map.设备效率改善项目启动时，用 OEE 量化可用率、性能率、合格率三大损失，定位最大: When launching an equipment efficiency improvement project, use OEE to quantify the three major losses — availability, performance and quality — and locate the biggest loss.
map.班前会设定 OEE 目标（世界级 ≥85%），对比各班组/产线，驱动 TPM 与: Set an OEE target at the pre-shift meeting (world class ≥ 85%), compare teams and lines, and drive TPM together with the elimination of minor stoppages.
map.新设备验收或工艺改造前后，用 OEE 前后对比验证改善效果。: When accepting new equipment or before and after a process change, compare OEE before and after to verify the improvement.
map.某设备计划运行 480 分钟（8 小时班）、非计划停机 60 分钟、单件节拍 1: A machine is planned to run 480 minutes (an 8-hour shift), with 60 minutes of unplanned downtime, a cycle time of 120 seconds per piece, 200 pieces produced and 195 good pieces. Availability = (480 − 60) ÷ 480 = 87.5%; theoretical output = 420 × 60 ÷ 120 = 210 pieces, performance = 200 ÷ 210 ≈ 95.2%; quality = 195 ÷ 200 = 97.5%; OEE = 87.5% × 95.2% × 97.5% ≈ 81.2% (close to the good level). The losses come mainly from downtime (12.5%) and small speed losses.
map.OEE 三个因子哪个最该优先改善？: Which of the three OEE factors should be improved first?
map.先看损失最大的因子。可用率损失（停机/换型）通常改善空间最大，可推 TPM；性能: Start with the factor that loses the most. Availability losses (downtime and changeover) usually offer the biggest room for improvement and can be addressed with TPM; performance losses mostly come from minor stoppages and reduced speed; quality losses depend on process control. World class OEE is ≥ 85% (availability ≥ 90%, performance ≥ 95%, quality ≥ 99%).
map.OEE 和产能利用率有什么区别？: What is the difference between OEE and capacity utilization?
map.产能利用率只看产出/理论产能，忽略停机、速度、质量损失；OEE 同时纳入可用率×: Capacity utilization only looks at output ÷ theoretical capacity and ignores downtime, speed and quality losses; OEE includes availability × performance × quality, reflecting effective output more truthfully, and is the more comprehensive efficiency indicator in manufacturing.
